name: Respect
source:
Respect is a visual novel where you play as a resident in an assisted living facility. You will have to navigate through tense situations as you communicate with different characters and experience different aspects of the care facility.

[From [url=https://sprinkle-theory.itch.io/respect]Itch.io[/url]]
